tool_args.rationale: The ten observations resolve a smooth saturating dependence on current input and a substantial gradient effect at the target horizon. Numerically fit several compact saturating response families and select by leave-one-out prediction before fresh confirmation. Dependence on the fixed temporal inputs remains unidentified.

considered_alternatives.option: Queue blowup or linear Little's Law snapshot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed current-input response saturates rather than growing linearly or diverging; gradient variation also changes the response.
All observations have identical past input, state, memory and horizon, so its temporal parameters are not identifiable from these measurements.
The available trajectory batch has already been acquired and did not vary the temporal inputs; the nuisance measurement is irrelevant.
